programme.title: Newscast
programme.desc: Join BBC journalists including political editor Laura Kuenssberg, Europe editor Katya Adler, Brussels correspondent Adam Fleming and political correspondent Chris Mason in their weekly podcast discussing all of the news stories that matter to the people of the United Kingdom. The journalists know all about the stories that they're talking about - they interview the most important people involved in the stories that feature in the news. They speak of their knowledge and understanding of the news in a way that is understandable for all. Laura is often in a car in the middle of a city where big politics stories are happening. Katya, Adam and Chris are usually in the studio. They regularly talk about Brexit and what is going to happen when the United Kingdom leaves the European Union.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.desc: Mike Hodges' film is a gloriously kitsch update of the 1930s comic strip and film series, starring Sam J Jones as the American football star Flash Gordon, who's transported, along with the beautiful Dale Arden (Melody Anderson), by Dr Zarkov (Topol) into the realm of the most evil ruler in the universe, the Emperor Ming (Max von Sydow). Only by uniting those under Ming's merciless rule to join his revolution can Flash save Earth from destruction. The unashamedly over-the-top Queen soundtrack is matched by Danilo Donati's effervescent production design, and the film also stars Brian Blessed as the chief of the Hawkmen, Timothy Dalton as the leader of the Treemen, and Ornella Muti as Ming's daughter, whose lascivious designs on Flash are just one of the challenges he must overcome if he's to end Ming's tyranny.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: Louise Violet
programme.desc: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

programme.title: The Face of Love
programme.desc: Several years after the death of her husband, a widow meets a stranger who greatly resembles her late husband, from his striking blue eyes to his kindness and humor, and falls in love with him, and, again, meets the love of her life.

programme.title: The Fabulous Patars
programme.desc: After the death of his beloved spouse, Denis, a loving father, is struggling with the education of his two daughters, Jenine and Mercredi, and his two jobs. When he forgets to pick Mercredi up from school, the director calls the social services. Severine, a social investigator, forces Denis to attend parenting classes, under penalty of withdrawing the custody of his daughters…

programme.title: Borderline
programme.desc: An attorney stumbles upon a suitcase filled with cocaine.

programme.title: Last Orders
programme.desc: On a cold winter day, Bear puts on his nightcap and decides to take a nice winter's nap. However, it would seem that others in the Big Blue House have other plans for Bear. Ojo comes to Bear in alarm --- concerned about the sudden disappearance of her duck friends from the Otter Pond. Bear makes her a cup of cocoa and tells her about migration. Treelo takes Bear outside, telling him there's feathers falling from the sky. Bear introduces him to the delights of snow. Bear finally settles down for the nap, but is woken up by Pip and Pop. They take him outside, where all the kids have a special surprise for him. Tutter's been trying to take a nap too, but with all the noise, he finds himself just as awake as Bear. In the Shadow segment, Shadow tries to help Bear get to sleep. She sings "Rockabye Baby." Songs In the Middle of Winter Notes In this episode, Ojo talks about her duck friends out at the Otter Pond. Duck characters were first seen on the program in the third season, with the introduction of Harry and his Mom in "Lost and Found."

programme.title: Borders
programme.desc: Adjara, Emma, and Sali meet in a bus. All three are heading for Lagos on the Bamako-Ouagadougou-Cotonou bus route. Broken down cars, road blockers, theft between passengers, this journey is to become a real nightmare. But the toughest challenge is crossing the borders.

programme.title: Venus
programme.desc: Roger Michell's romantic drama stars Oscar-nominated Peter O'Toole as Maurice, a respected but ageing actor who spends his time between jobs meeting up with his friends Ian (Leslie Phillips) and Donald (Richard Griffiths) for tea and gossip in the local café. But his life changes when Ian's family land him with his grand niece Jessie (Jodie Whittaker), ostensibly as Ian's carer but in fact to distance her from a family crisis of her making. Maurice falls for her and takes her under his wing but what begins as a mismatched, disturbing relationship ends up a touchingly warm friendship between two people who, decades apart in age, recognise they are kindred spirits.

programme.title: Lolita
programme.desc: Controversial adaptation of Vladimir Nabokov's novel about a man's obsession with a 13-year-old girl. In an American town in the late 1940s, a European professor takes up residence in the home of a woman and her daughter. Although eventually marrying the mother, he harbours a secret desire for the young girl. And when the mother dies, the middle-aged man's infatuation with the teenager runs amok - with shocking consequences.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Miami
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Miami is a documentary reality series following dedicated animal control officers as they provide a valuable service to the animals of Miami-Dade County. Keeping a close eye on the region's creatures, both wild and domesticated, the control officers visit various locations to investigate reports of injured or sick animals, and deplorable cases of animal cruelty, ensuring they are provided with the welfare they deserve. The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

programme.title: Animal ER
programme.desc: Gulf Coast Veterinary Specialists is a high-tech surgical animal hospital serving the greater Houston area. The over 200 Doctors and technicians see over 50,000 patients a year from every walk of life. Over the course of the week, the staff sees several exotic animals and many dogs with advanced health concerns. Mikka, an 18-foot reticulated python finally slithers still for a set of radiographs to insure against pneumonia. Coco the Dalmatian needs a risky surgery to remove a cyst that is hampering her spinal function. The Houston Zoo brings two animals in, Old Lady, a 31 year old Blue-Billed Curassow with a broken leg that Dr. Brian Beale surgically repairs, and Smoots the Meerkat, who gets a tooth extraction from Dr. Chanda Miles.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: The Vet Life
programme.desc: The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: The Pool Master
programme.desc: The Pool Master is a show presented by Anthony Archer-Wills, a top pool expert, landscape architect and artist. Team of professionals lead by him design and build amazing one-of-a-kind pools, which are in great demand among homeowners. After seeing masterpiece by Anthony, you will never agree to have a rectangle with water for swimming. Multipurpose pools for exercising and entertainment full of flowers, waterfalls, decorated with natural stone according to every taste and wallet will take your breath away.

programme.title: Return To Shark Island
programme.desc: Shark scientist Dr. Craig O'Connell, and Réunion's CRA Shark Protection Program, investigates the ongoing shark crisis that is threatening this former island paradise.

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Bad Dog
programme.desc: BAD DOG! is a hilarious hour of television documenting just how far pets can push their owners and still get unconditional love. The series highlights dogs that double as destroyers, hissing cats, cussing parrots, and the most fascinating four-legged escape artists ever caught on tape. Viewers will be treated to candid animal antics you truly have to see to believe. They are some of the baddest pets on the planet and you'll meet their owners who love them just the way they are. We span the globe to crown the Baddest of the Bad on BAD DOG!.

programme.title: Rugged Justice
programme.desc: Animal Planet's Rugged Justice follows the officers from Washington State's Department of Fish and Wildlife Law Enforcement as they guard the vast borders. It is an elite unit that protect people and wildlife, patrolling coastal areas, mountainous terrains and rugged roads of rainforests. Every day brings a new challenge, dispatchers receive around 25.000 calls annually, every of which requires prompt reaction.

programme.title: Tanked

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

Representing the city's the diverse cuisine, the chefs will have to strategize what ingredients to use in round one in hopes to knock Alex out of the competition. Judges Marcus Samuelsson and Leah Cohen keep the Big Apple in mind as the remaining chefs use their skills to vie for the top spot.

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
programme.desc: Features one competitor per episode who enters Bobby's secret kitchen to compete against professional chefs in three head-to-head rounds. If the competitor can out-cook the titans and earn more points, they take home the cash prize.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

Using their remarkable sense of smell, which is up to 100,000 times more effective than that of humans, these policing pooches unearth deadly narcotics, smuggled goods such as ivory and even illegal immigrants. In this reality series we celebrate these canine crime fighters and the unbreakable bonds they have with their human handlers, showcasing their incredible abilities when out on call with UK police officers.

programme.desc: King of Kings, one of the most recognizable brands in the world of kickboxing, returns to live action on FightBox HD. KOK brings the most dedicated fans to the biggest arenas in the world to create an amazing spectacle.

programme.title: Kickboxing: KOK World Series
programme.desc: Enjoy all the action and drama from the these competition bouts between the latest crop of top kickboxing fighters as they go toe-to-toe in this adrenalin-packed showcase. All of your favourite fight stars will be making an appearance including current heavyweight champ Dzevad Poturak from Bosnia. The nine contests across all weight divisions feature fighters from Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Republic of Serbia, and Montenegro.

programme.title: Dream Boxing
programme.desc: DREAM BOXING stands as one of the most successful boxing promotions companies in the Europe for one reason: We take care of our fighters and our fans. It's a practice we continue to this day,as we further expand the DREAM BOXING brand while introducing the sport of boxing to a new generation of fans. Our fighters hail from around the world, attract a global audience, and span the ranks, from up-and-coming prospects to title contenders to world champions. We discover new talents, having a huge experience in amateurs ring, world and europe champions.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Gold Rush: Freddy Dodge's Mine Rescue
programme.desc: In the Yukon, Freddy and Juan tackle their most extensive treasure hunt yet: 288 claims across 6,000 acres and double the breakdowns. As the seconds tick away on the miner's season, the duo teams up with a local expert to find the gold.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Meet modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard. With demanding customers, high turnover, and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life!

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: The local social cricket team are up to bat and sometimes it seems they are one batsman short of of an eleven. There are good secrets and not so good secrets that come to light during the course of the day. Roger is the ultimate captain rallying his troops whilst ignoring his greatest strength, Miriam, who makes the 'fantastic' teas with or without the 'non-compulsory' help. The days builds to a climax where it seems that everything must change forever. But will it?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: Farmhouse Fixer
programme.desc: The nostalgia, charm and history behind New England farmhouses are a few of the reasons Jonathan Knight loves to restore old homes. With the help of his designer, Kristina, Jonathan works to keep that history alive by breathing new life into the homes.

programme.title: Mike Brewer's World of Cars
programme.desc: Car trader and vehicle fanatic Mike Brewer travels Britain and the United States looking for expert craftsmen in this automotive documentary series. He meets with diverse individuals who share his passion for finding, building, and most importantly, driving cars. Adding various pit stops to his jam-packed journey, including breweries, distilleries, and eateries, Mike gets stuck into the American way of life. Whether it's learning more about the birth of NASCAR in Charlotte, North Carolina, meeting with the king of custom builds Gene Winfield, or seeing the work of British Motor Heritage who produce key components for Minis and MGs, each leg of his adventure is full of creative characters and superb cars.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Unique American reality series that follows a group of friends in Utah- David ''Heavy D'' Sparks, David ''Diesel Dave'' Kiley, and their crew at ''DieselSellerz'' who sell parts for diesel trucks and jeeps, repair and customize pickup trucks. They design and build some of the biggest and most amazing diesel powered vehicles you will ever see, and also do truck giveaways. Watch as they create these awesome masterpieces and enjoy all the crazy adventures they get into while doing it.

programme.title: Race Night At Bowman Gray
programme.desc: It's week two at the infamous Bowman Gray Stadium, and reigning champ Burt Myers hopes for two more wins, while Tim Brown fears a hand injury might end his season early. Jason Myers rushes to repair his battered car and get his season back on track.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: As the modern world becomes progressively automated and mechanised it's easy to become detached from how things are made and how they work. The hit series returns to uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How the seemingly mundane are often the result of highly sophisticated engineering and production processes. This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: Border Control: Spain
programme.desc: The documentary series accompanies the border guards of Spain in their daily fight against crime - on land, at sea and in the air. Around the clock, the men and women are on duty to pre-empt drug traffickers, smugglers and smugglers. The role of the security forces is manifold: from the fight against hashish transport in the strait of Gibraltar to the smashing of organized human trafficking at the airport in Madrid to the search for counterfeit branded goods in the port of Barcelona.

programme.title: Mike Brewer: Born Dealer
programme.desc: Mike Brewer tests the market with a customised pick-up. Mrs. Brewer hatches an expansion plan, and the team take on an 1980s hot hatch restoration.

programme.title: Last Chance Garage
programme.desc: Specialty car restoration mistakes are much more common than you'd think, and each episode of LAST CHANCE GARAGE features a car with a horrifying backstory: multiple shops, years lost, and tens of thousands of dollars in sunk costs. On the flip side of that struggle, audiences will see the customer and learn about their unique - and often deeply personal - connection to their car.

programme.title: Caught!
programme.desc: When crooks and criminals run for freedom, the police aren't far behind. Lawbreakers will utilise every tool at their disposal to make their escape.

programme.title: Caught!
programme.desc: Protesting air passengers create turbulence for everyone on board. However, when mechanical issues arise, that's when the real chaos begins.

programme.title: Caught!
programme.desc: In high-velocity situations, life-or-death decisions come in quick succession. When police officers are in the line of fire, all bets are off.

programme.title: Caught!
programme.desc: IPhones and surveillance cameras capture theft, violence, shameless behavior and embarrassingly funny moments. Join unsuspecting subjects as the cameras capture what they didn't want you to see.

programme.title: The Bad Foot Clinic
programme.desc: Severe fungal foot and nail infections, warts, corns, webbed toes, bunions and verrucas are all in a day's work for leading podiatrist Marion Yau and her GP husband Dr Kenny. Together, they tackle extreme and debilitating foot conditions.

programme.title: Inside the Kim Kardashian Heist
programme.desc: CCTV, wiretaps and the DNA left at the scene of the Kim Kardashian diamond heist soon have the cops closing in on a surprising gang of suspects.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress America
programme.desc: Looking for your perfect dress? Kleinfeld Bridal is the place for you. Follow brides as they head off on their search for the perfect wedding dress, no matter how big or small in the city of New York. Bringing their friends and family along to help them decide, will they girls trip to the store be an easy one? The brides are each assisted by a consultant during a private shopping event, the outcome being that all important dress.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.desc: The series brings three American men and 12 international women together on a remote paradise island for a chance at finding romance. And here's the twist: none of the women speak English and none of the men speak other languages. Without being able to speak to one another and without the use of translators, the singles need to count on their senses to help develop their connection and determine the power of their chemistry and attraction.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: Take My Tumor

Osborne take on some of the most challenging cases of their careers. Patients from all over the world, are looking to get their lives back and these surgeons are their last hope. This intense series highlights unique patients, difficult surgeries, and life-changing procedures.

programme.desc: Margot and her canine friends continue their pioneering trapping adventure, pushing deeper into the rugged Yukon backcountry. Desperate for building materials for his island homestead, Matty takes to the seas in search of timber. Billy turns his attention to fixing one of the most essential of all backwoods buildings: the outhouse. Emilie and Gilbert take their daughter Annie on her first hunting trip.

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: As temperatures plunge, Margot looks to her dogs to help her seriously raise her wood-harvesting game. Emilie and Gilbert travel to a remote, frozen lake, hoping to net a haul of food for their family. Yearning to bring a little more light into his backwoods life, Billy begins work on an off-grid power system, and Matty heads indoors to complete the latest and perhaps greatest of all his "Hillbilly" building projects.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: December 27th, 1991 -- Scandinavian Airlines Flight #751 is negotiating snow and slush on the tarmac at Stockholm-Arlanda Airport. The DC-9 has been de-iced twice to ensure it's safe for take-off. Despite the winter conditions, the aircraft takes off smoothly. But within seconds, the engines begin emitting a series of rapid-fire booming noises, smoke begins filtering through the cabin, and less than two minutes later, both engines fail. As the pilots try restarting them, the left engine erupts in flames. 3,200 feet above the ground, the plane has lost all power and is falling quickly and silently from the sky. The plane hits the ground, breaking into three pieces, but remarkably everyone on board survives. But can investigators determine what brought down the nearly new, state-of-the-art jetliner?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Chris Hemsworth: a Road Trip to Remember
programme.desc: Ocean Oasis, a new giant-screen film, is a fascinating journey into the bountiful seas and pristine deserts of two remarkably different, but inextricably linked worlds — Mexico's Sea of Cortés and the Baja California desert. What powerful geologic forces collided to carve out this unique region? What drives the strong currents that make this ocean so unusually rich in nutrients? How does life thrive in a seemingly barren landscape? Ocean Oasis mesmerizes us with revealing and memorable scenes that explore these mysteries. Glide side-by-side with a graceful giant manta ray as it arches and swoops through water sparkling under the hot Baja California sun. Witness the pageant of migrating whales, the elaborate tango of courting terns, the battles of lumbering elephant seals. Fly over sweeping vistas of snow-capped mountains, vast deserts, palm oases, and mangrove swamps — then plunge into astonishing underwater sequences of rarely seen marine life. Ocean Oasis is both visually stunning and provocative, compelling in its message that this little-known region is a treasure worth preserving

programme.title: Building Impossible with Daniel Ashville
programme.desc: After the horrifying Hindenburg crash, the airship industry was grounded for good - until now. Daniel visits Silicon Valley, where a team of visionaries is building a colossal airship that may revolutionize air travel. Daniel joins the team as they prepare to float the 122 meter, 28 ton ship, making it one of the largest airborne vehicles in the world.

programme.title: Rome Underground
programme.desc: Featuring the parallel stories of a supersize building project and a jaw-dropping archaeological adventure, Rome Underground takes viewers on an immersive journey deep under the Eternal City — revealing how the construction of a 26-kilometer subway line through the heart of historic Rome has literally unearthed some of the most important discoveries of the modern age. At the intersection of technology and archaeology, this documentary chronicles the ambitious mega-project from every angle. With state-of-the-art modelling and 3D animation, it brings the ancient world vividly to life.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: 12 August, 1985 saw the deadliest single-aircraft accident in aviation history. Japan Airlines Flight 123 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight carrying 524 people from Tokyo to Osaka. Just 12 minutes into the flight, the Boeing 747 jumbo-jet suffered a fatal decompression that ripped off most of the tail. With a total loss of hydraulics, the crew were unable to control the aircraft which tragically crashed into a mountainside. This episode features the account of a widowed partner of one passenger who perished in the crash, on why the grief from the tragedy still lives on..

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: On 19 July 1989, United Airlines Flight 232 was making its regularly scheduled flight from Denver to Chicago when the DC-10 aircraft suffered a catastrophic failure to the tail-engine. The crew onboard faced the impossible task of landing with a total loss of control. 112 passengers perished in the horrific crash but thanks to the incredible crew, 184 people survived the fifth-deadliest crash involving a DC-10. In this episode we hear from multiple survivors as well as the first-officer, Bill Records, who gives a rare first-hand account from the cockpit, of what could have been the crew's final moments..

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: Plane Crash Recreated Plane Crash Recreated 10 x 60' As passengers, every time we board an aeroplane, we place our trust in the pilot, airline and the aircraft manufacturer and while flying remains the safest form of travel, accidents still happen. 'Plane Crash Recreated' will explain and investigate the world's most infamous plane crashes. Using survivor stories, expert interviews and black-box data, we will experience the final harrowing moments on board these notorious flights. But could the outcome have been different? Using a team of highly skilled test pilots and our own cutting edge flight simulator, we show you the extreme pressure inside the cockpit. When faced with failure, our military, commercial, aerobatic and test-pilots will need to make split-second life-or-death decisions. How will their vastly different training affect their outcome? And with the benefit of hindsight, what would they do differently?

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP discovers four kilograms of cocaine concealed within two cakes, and then HSI follows the case from Miami to Atlanta to dismantle an interstate smuggling ring. CBP Miami inspects a load of in-transit mail and uncovers two suspicious packages - a drum and machine part - that may contain narcotics. CBP New York cracks-down on the importation of illicit money, and investigates multiple travelers attempting to bring-in large sums of undeclared cash.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: In Thailand, elevated highways keep falling down. A fire breaks out at a bakery in a Uruguayan shopping mall, and a bridge in Colombia collapses just before construction is finished. London's skyline has become a buffet of unsightly skyscrapers, and trucks everywhere are overloaded. Without proper shoring, a building in Iowa crumbles and houses in Rodanthe keep plunging into the ocean.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: When a bridge on an interstate highway collapses, investigators realize the problem might not be the vehicles moving across it, but the ones that aren't. Speaking of things handling heavy traffic, one New York City garage learns why supporting columns are called supporting columns. Also, what went wrong with collapsing Chinese roads and a collapsing French airport, a burning question about apartment block cladding, and why a supertall skyscraper went crooked.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Easter Island's tall stone moai have long captured the global imagination, and there are still mysteries surrounding them. Out of nearly 1,000, why is one particular moai, called Tukuturi, the only one kneeling and sporting a beard? In 1950s USA, sightings of UFOs were a national phenomenon. Alien or not, many Americans didn't realize that the US military was working their own flying saucer: the Avrocar. And just after Newton's discoveries about gravity, 18th-century German physician Franz Anton Mesmer also proposed an invisible force that he called ""animal magnetism." To harness it, he built a device from a giant wooden tub saying it could cure any illness. Patients seemed to corroborate the claim, but could it be true?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A small commuter plane begins a short flight when disaster strikes. Moments after takeoff, the nose of the aircraft pitches up dramatically. The flight crew struggles for control. The plane is just 350 meters in the air when it stalls, rolls to the left, and plummets to the ground. It slams into a packed hangar, killing everyone on board. Combing through the wreckage, investigators find a single clue that leads them to uncover a string of errors and faulty assumptions that have been putting millions of passengers at risk for years.

programme.title: Ancient X Files
programme.desc: Ancient X Files travels around the world to solve some intriguing riddles. Each story is a piece of detective work by an expert trying to make sense of some puzzling ancient artefact, to find the truth behind some extraordinary legend, to discover the origins of a bizarre myth or to establish the authenticity of a venerated religious relic. This series explores the bits of archaeology and history which seem to defy explanation. Our experts are following chains of clues and putting theories to the test, in an effort to explain the unexplained. Ancient X Files investigates claims about the whereabouts of the lost Ark of the Covenant; attempts to establish the authenticity of a cup some believe to be the Holy Grail; tries to de-code the mysterious Phaistos disc; investigates a cloth which is believed to carry traces of the DNA of Jesus Christ; and deciphers an encrypted book of alchemy written by the great Sir Isaac Newton.

programme.title: Ancient X Files
programme.desc: Despite the claims of a famous work of fiction, never has a code been discovered in a painting by Leonardo Da Vinci. But new high resolution images of the Mona Lisa, taken to record its fading colours, may have revealed more than cracks in the varnish. One man believes he has found hidden numbers and letters. This episode follows the trail of a potential code…could it reveal the true meaning behind this enigmatic painting? Also in this episode, the world's oldest underground temple and discovered with up to 7,000 skeletons.

Rabeledes vihaste venelaste, Briti salaagentide, oma ilmatu pikkade jalgadega naise ja rahvusvahelise terroristi vahel, peab elurõõmus kunstikaupmees ja poole kohaga suli Charlie Mortdecai (Johnny Depp) minema teisele poole maakera. programme.title: Jäähoki MM
programme.desc: Jäähoki 2026. aasta maailmameister selgub 15. kuni 31. maini Šveitsis toimuval turniiril. Teekonda ihaldatud tiitli poole alustavad 16 meeskonda, kes on jaotatud kahte alagruppi. Zürichis mängivasse A alagruppi kuuluvad valitsev maailmameister USA, Šveits, Soome, Saksamaa, Läti, Austria, Ungari ja Suurbritannia. B alagruppi kuuluvad Kanada, Rootsi, Tšehhi, Taani, Slovakkia, Norra, Sloveenia ja Itaalia. See alagrupp mängib Fribourgis. Alagrupiturniir toimub 15. kuni 26. maini. Mõlemast alagrupist 4 paremat pääsevad rehamängudele kaheksa parema hulka. Veerandfinaalid mängitakse 28. mail. Poolfinaalid mängitakse 30. mail. 3.-4. koha mäng ja finaal mängitakse pühapäeval, 31. mail.

Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga. Sevilla - Real Madrid
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.desc: Burns teatab oma alluvatele, et sulgeb vabriku ning avab uue tehase Indias. Ainus töötaja, kelle ta alles otsustab jätta, on Homer, kes peab uued töötajad ise koolitama. Selmal ja Pattyl õnnestub Richard Dean Andreson röövida, kuid peagi on nende endi elud ohus.

programme.title: Ameerika paps
programme.desc: Abielu päästmiseks vajab Jeff, et Hayley end talle rohkem avaks, aga Hayley ei taha selles osaleda.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Amy plaanib jõululaupäeval korraldada viktoriaanliku õhtusöögi. Raj, Leonard ja Howard proovivad lahti saada tuvist, kes lendas ülikooli puhtasse ruumi. Pahur Sheldon tahab Amyle midagi tõestada ja ostab talle halvima võimaliku kingi.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Rallieksperdid võtavad sõnas ja pildis kokku kõik Monte Carlo rallil toimuva. Ralli põnevaimad hetked, intervjuud ekspertidega nii Eestist kui kohapealt, analüüs ja vaatajamängud. Saatejuhid: Kalev Kruus, Rauno Paltser, Margus Murakas ja Roland Murakas.

programme.title: Missioon "Fortuuna": suur pettus
programme.desc: Suurbritannia-USA- Indoneesia-Türgi 2023 märulikomöödia Eliitspioonil Orson Fortune'il tuleb takistada miljardärist relvadiilerit Greg Simmondsit surmavat uut relvatehnoloogiat müümast. Vastumeelselt maailma parimate agentidega koostööd tegev Fortune värbab ühes tiimiga maailma päästmise missioonile Hollywoodi suurima filmitähe Danny Francesco. Lavastaja: Guy Ritchie Osades: Jason Statham, Hugh Grant, Aubrey Plaza, Josh Hartnett

programme.title: Walker, Texase korravalvur
programme.desc: Walker mängib mehhiklast, et välja uurida, kes smuugeldab USAsse odavat tööjõudu.

programme.title: Doktor Silva
programme.desc: Silval õnnestub peale staariskandaali enda autoriteet taastada, aga nüüd peab tegelema hambaarst Orto probleemiga, kellel tuleb viimaks hügieeninõudeid täitma hakata. Ortole antakse ultimaatum - ta kas muutub 24 tunniga korralikuks ja puhtaks hambaarstiks või peab keskusest lahkuma. Samal ajal üritab aga kõigi poolt hüljatud endine perearst Heimar oma äsjasele liitlasele Estrile kätte maksta ja keskuses hakkab sulgi lendama.

programme.title: Suvesangarid
programme.desc: "Suvesangarid" on lustlik suvine saade, mis tõestab, et igas Eestimaa nurgas on midagi vaatamist ja katsetamist väärt. Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

Mari ootamatu kohtumine Mammu klassijuhatajaga võtab üllatava suuna. Piret üritab Sirjet mõjutada, kuid ema ei võta teda kuulda. Erik paraneb, kuid Maimu mõõt saab lõpuks täis.

Stephanie tahab teenindaja Jordaniga lõbutseda, kuid ka ehtsat lähedust leida. Donna ja Tony leiavad end pärast pikkade suhete lõppu taas kohtingute maastikult. Chris ja Haley otsivad uusi algusi ning Lauren loodab, et just Alan on see karismaatiline mees, keda tema otsib.

programme.desc: Seyran tunneb end halvasti, kui Feritit Nevraga koos näeb. Pelin on Seyranile abi ja nõu eest tänulik. Kui saabub uudis, et Kazim on kadunud, asub Ferit teda otsima. Sanlide pere on suures mures ja nad kardavad halvimat. Seyran kuuleb, et Kazim toimetati kriitilises seisus haiglasse ning ta tõttab sinna. Ta näeb seal Feritit ja mõistab, et ta aitas Kazimit päästa. Ifakat saab teada, et Orhan on kuriteo taga, kuid ta hoiatab Latifit, et ta Halisile midagi ei räägiks.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Pärast normannide sissetungi Inglismaale 1186. aastal armuvad Rob - saksist metsniku poeg - ja Marian, normannist maaomaniku tütar, teineteisesse ning hakkavad koos õigluse ja vabaduse eest võitlema.

programme.title: Viini veri
programme.desc: Sigmund Freudi õpilane Max Liebermann aitab 20. sajandi alguse Viinis, nooblite kohvikute ja ooperimajade linnas, Oskar Rheinhardtil uurida häirivat mõrvaseeriat.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised

programme.desc: Mehhikos, 300 meetri sügavusel asub Kristallkoobas. Varjulises koopas peituvad ühed maailma suurimad kristallid!

programme.title: Rebased ja mägrad
programme.desc: Roosi ja Laanekas lõhuvad kogemata Skautmägra kaisukaru ära. Kas neil õnnestub see salaja ära parandada?

programme.title: Pips ja Popi
programme.desc: Popi ei leia kusagilt Krooksu ja sõbrad mängivad tema leidmiseks detektiive.

programme.title: Röövlitütar Ronja
programme.desc: Mattis on röövinud Birki ja nõuab Borka röövlisalga lahkumist nende lossist. Ronja julge tegu muudab aga kogu olukorda.

programme.title: Floor paneb reeglid paika!
programme.desc: Floor otsustab modelliks hakata, kuid avastab peagi, et modellielu pole mingi meelakkumine.

programme.title: Claude
programme.desc: Turistide tarbeks tehakse reklaafilmi "Tere tulemast Käpalinna". Claude'ist saab filmitäht.

programme.title: Tom Gatesi äge maailm
programme.desc: Täna meisterdame ise pilli ning rokime Florence'i ja Naerunägudega.

programme.title: Anna ja sõbrad

programme.title: Ruudu ja Tupsu

programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Stella ja Sam
programme.desc: 9-aastane Stella pole oma 4-aastasele vennale üksnes vanem õde, vaid ka parim sõber ja teejuht nende tagaaia maagilises maailmas. Stellale pole aed lihtsalt aed, vaid kaaslasi täis mängumaa. Koos Stellaga õpib Sam ruttu selgeks, et näpuotsatäie kujutlusvõimega on võimalik muuta tool kosmoseraketiks, et aasadel pesitsevad draakonid ja et puud võivad osutuda ideaalseteks piraadilaevadeks. Nende seikluste käigus tekib Samil alati palju küsimusi ja kuigi Stella ei pea kuigi palju faktidest kinni, ei jää ta nendele vastamisel kunagi hätta. Täna on Stella ja Sam superkangelased.

programme.title: Ringvaade
programme.desc: "Ringvaade" toob vaatajate ette Eesti elu kirevaimad tegelased ja suurimad seiklused. Saatejuhid Grete Lõbu ja Marko Reikop.

programme.title: Tee oma tee
programme.desc: Kevadel tuleb põhikooliõpilastel langetada otsus, kuidas oma haridusteed jätkata. Ühe unistuseni võib viia mitu teed, millest kõik on õiged. Saatejuhid Paula Rits ja Gustav Kõrvits käivad mõned teed ise läbi ning jagavad oma kogemusi ka vaatajatele. Režissöör Märten Vaher, toimetaja Marit Ummelas, produtsent Mai Kangro.

programme.title: Uudishimu tippkeskus
programme.desc: Läheme teadlastega välitöödele kaasa ja surfame geoloogia laineharjal tuhandeid aastaid minevikku ning kümneid aastaid tulevikku, et otsida järve põhjast mägesid ja metsa alt rannavalle. Kas teadsid, et Pirita valge liiv on pärit sisemaalt või et vanad eestlased küttisid pringleid? Saatejuht-peatoimetaja Maarja Merivoo-Parro, režissöör Andres Lepasar, tegevprodutsent Carmen-Louise Suuroja.

programme.title: Kalifaat
programme.desc: Fatima üritab oma ülemust veenda, et on saanud olulist luureinfot. Pervin jääb vahele, mobiil näpus, ja on sunnitud langetama saatusliku otsuse. Sulle isa on maruvihane, kui tütar hidžaabiga koju tuleb.

programme.title: Vana aja asjad
programme.desc: Arhiivimaterjalidele tuginev sari, mis esitab tegelikkust ajavahemikul 1960-1985, eelkõige selle aja asju. Saade "Kodune majapidamine" näitab asju, mida vana aja kodust leida võis - laudu, toole, diivaneid, sektsioonkappe, sekka ka mõned televiisorid, raadiod ja telefonid. Režissöör Hanna Šein, tekst Mati Unt. Produtsendid Olavi Paide ja Kiur Aarma. Tootja Eetriüksus OÜ.

programme.title: Riigikogu infotund
programme.desc: Otseülekanne Riigikogu infotunnist, kus peaminister ja ministrid vastavad Riigikogu liikmete küsimustele.

programme.title: Esimene stuudio
programme.desc: Saatesari avab erinevaid päevakajalisi teemasid, mis sünnivad meie igapäeva-elust, alates poliitikast ja majandusest, lõpetades sotsiaalia ning kultuuriga. Saatejuhid Andres Kuusk, Johannes Tralla ja Mirko Ojakivi. Režissöör Maarika Lauri, produtsent Tiina-Mari Koljak.

programme.title: Teater laulab
programme.desc: Laulab Pärnu Endla teatri ansambel koosseisus Margus Oopkaup, Peeter Kaljumäe ja Sepo Seeman. Režissöör Kalev Lepik, operaator Robert Vood, toimetaja Anne Tuuling. Täna on Peeter Kaljumäel 60. sünnipäev. Palju õnne!

programme.title: Muutuv planeet
programme.desc: Kliimamuutuse ja inimtegevuse mõjul on ohus paljud me planeedi ökosüsteemid. Teadlased uurivad Islandi liustike sulamise tagajärgi Põhja-Jäämere küürvaaladele, Tonle Sapi järve kalavarude kiire kahanemise põhjuseid Kambodžas ja näeme ka Keenia inimeste pingutusi, et tulla toime aina pikenevate põuaperioodidega.

programme.title: Operatsioon Ai
programme.desc: Tule avasta põnevaid teadmisi inimkehast. Sarja juhivad kaksikud dr Chris ja dr Xand van Tulleken, kes teevad teaduslikke katseid ja uurivad meditsiini ning bioloogia huvitavat maailma. Saa üle hirmust haigla ees ja vaata oma silmaga, mida põnevat seal tegelikult tehakse ning millised uskumatud protsessid meie kehas toimuvad. Suurbritannia linnades filmitud sarjas näeme päris patsiente kriisiolukorras ja meie arstid Chris ning Xand näitavad, kui põnevalt toimib kiirabi ja milleks on meie keha suuteline äärmuslikes olukordades.

programme.title: Susapusa Okidos
programme.desc: Susapusa joob palaval päeval mullivett ja see paneb ta aevastama. Miks on mullivees mullid ja kuidas need sinna sisse saavad?

Ta on valitsenud muusikaedetabeleid, mänginud filmides ja tema mõju ulatub kaugele väljapoole meelelahutusskeenet. Täna on Cheril 80. sünnipäev.

programme.desc: Peeter on kupleekuningas. Kuplee kui žanr on koos temaga vajumas unustuse hõlma. Kuidas leppida paratamatusega ja toime tulla stressiga, kui kadumas on kõik, mille nimel seni elatud?
